input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Most of Section 19 already meets our position: 19.1 gives the professional-and-workmanlike standard plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law and no malicious code; 19.4 gives the full re-perform/repair/replace remedy escalating to termination and refund of Fees, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims; and the 19.5 disclaimer is confined to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy. The single gap is the duration of the Deliverable conformity warranty in 19.2, which is only ninety days. Deliverables under Section 1.4 include configurations, integrations and other software-like work product, and our preferred position is a 12-month conformity period for software (90 days being the fallback). We therefore redline 19.2 to twelve (12) months, which also states the period unambiguously in numerals; hosted Services conformity for the full subscription term and the 19.4 remedy are unchanged. Ninety (90) days remains an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformity warranty from ninety days to twelve (12) months and state the period in numerals.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformity warranty in 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months, since Deliverables include software, configurations and integrations whose defects typically surface over a full operating cycle; our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for services. The remedy in 19.4 is unchanged, and we can accept ninety (90) days as a fallback if the longer period is not workable.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
